cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 12 since October 2025. She won a 2025 special election to the seat vacated by Corey Harbison. Wikipedia says she had a twenty-year career as a realtor.
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where she was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We found no stated positions or documented actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership, growth and development, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. Ballotpedia says she did not complete its 2025 or 2026 candidate surveys and lists no endorsements for her. Its sponsored-legislation section was empty in the page we read. Her real estate career is mentioned only briefly, with no employer or details.

qual.background: She has held the District 12 House seat since October 2025, after a special election win. Before that she had a career of about twenty years as a realtor.
qual.why: She has legislative service, but only about one year of it. Her real estate career is a business background, not law, policy or budget work. That puts her between the middle and high bands.
